verdict.rationale: AWS is a cloud platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question here. The evidence shows AWS itself publishes open-source MCP servers under the official awslabs GitHub org, but it is limited to a repo title and a probe line, with no detail on setup, covered services, auth, or how an agent connects. missing for 10: documented connection/configuration steps for agents, scope of services and tools exposed, auth model for the MCP servers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
